conclusion: Stored Goop-3D step_context, when present, is unused by the released parser/model input contract because exact official Goop-3D metadata lacks context_mean. Training and rollout propagate step_context only if the parser returned it; features.get yields None otherwise. Context normalization is created only if metadata supplies context_mean.
